🔥 D.C.’S BIGGEST BOLLYWOOD NEW YEAR PARTY! 🔥
Get ready for the most electrifying New Year’s Eve celebration as Tamasha Nights brings its signature Bollywood magic to Downtown Washington, D.C.!
After a year of unforgettable parties, we're turning up the energy even higher to welcome 2027 in unforgettable style!
One Venue. One Dance Floor. One Superstar DJ. One Epic Countdown.
When the clock strikes midnight, there's only one place to be- THROW SOCIAL NIGHTCLUB, located in the heart of Downtown D.C.!
Get ready for a night of glamour, high-energy beats, nonstop dancing, and an unforgettable Bollywood countdown experience!

💃 THE EXPERIENCEStep into Throw Social Nightclub– Downtown D.C., where nightlife, entertainment, and high-energy vibes come together for one spectacular night!
For New Year's Eve, Tamasha Nights transforms the venue into the ultimate Bollywood party destination.
✨ One massive dance floor, incredible sound and lighting, and nonstop music featuring the best of Bollywood, Punjabi, Bhangra & Top 40!

🎧 FEATURING – FROM THE UK!
Get ready for an unforgettable musical experience with DJ HARPZ, the Punjabi & Bollywood master bringing international energy, explosive mixes, and signature sounds straight from the UK to D.C.!
From chart-topping Bollywood anthems to Punjabi bangers and dancefloor favorites, DJ Harpz is ready to keep you moving all night long!

🎧 THE COUNTDOWN – WELCOME 2027!Join hundreds of partygoers as we scream the count down together to welcome 2027!
